title: Kajol Reveals She's Had Issues With Ajay Devgn In The Past: 'Whatever Complaints I Had…'
text:
Kajol Reveals She's Had Issues With Ajay Devgn In The Past: ‘Whatever Complaints I Had…'
Kajol reveals that any marital complaints she had about Ajay Devgn have been resolved.
Kajol and Ajay Devgn have been married for over two decades, balancing their personal life with two demanding film careers. But after 26 years, Kajol says any past complaints about their relationship are behind them. In a recent chat with Instant Bollywood, Kajol spoke about how Ajay’s frequent film shoots sometimes take him away from home, which has both pros and cons.
See more: Kajol Says Working With Ajay Devgn Is ‘90% Calling Each Other Out’
Recommended Stories
“Both are good and bad. Kabhi kabhi aisa lagta hai ki achha huya 40 din ka outdoor hai aur kabhi kabhi lagta hai he should have been at home for somethings," she said, admitting that while the distance can help sometimes, there are moments she wishes he was around more.
She went on to add that over time, they’ve found their rhythm and learned to adapt to each other’s lifestyles. “But we have been together for so many years and it’s a life that we have lived together. So it had all become a part of the habit, I think we have gotten used to it. He is very passionate and he wouldn’t be what he is today if he could not make films," she said.
When asked if there’s anything that still bothers her about Ajay, Kajol replied, “I don’t have any complaints. Whatever complaints I had, we have resolved them and they are way in the past."
Kajol and Ajay first met on the sets of Hulchul in 1995 and tied the knot in 1999. The couple are parents to two children, Nysa and Yug.
Kajol is gearing up for the release of her upcoming horror film Maa, directed by Vishal Furia and produced by her husband Ajay Devgn. The film is slated to hit theatres on June 27. Maa also stars Ronit Roy, Indraneil Sengupta, and Surjyasikha Das. Backed by Devgn Films and Jio Studios, the film promises a gripping mix of mythology and horror.
